Title: Material-return credit settled the client's oldest bill
What was changed: MaterialReturn gains source_sale_id/source_bill_no (auto-migrated); the return resolves the bill explicitly (form field 'Against Sale Bill') or by newest matching sale/material; the settlement projection takes an explicit target before falling back to FIFO; the rebuild replay honours it too.
Evidence: Bill B 1,600 -> 0 with bill A untouched at 1,500; auto-detected return settled bill C 17,000 -> 16,150.

Title: Dashboard Daily Due dropped a delivered booking's value
What was changed: due_on_delivered_goods() now withholds only each booking's OWN undelivered value (_booking_undelivered_by_booking) instead of clamping against the client total.
Evidence: Delivered booking contributes 16,000: due 31,100 instead of the old 13,000-style shortfall; tile equals the engine.

Title: Undelivered tile multiplied the client value by booking count
What was changed: The per-booking undelivered value is accumulated once per booking, so the tile equals the client plan total.
Evidence: Tile 30,000 = client ledger 30,000 with three bookings (was 90,000).

Title: Total Outstanding / Current Payables counted undelivered bookings
What was changed: build_current_payables() now withholds the client's undelivered booking commitment from the receivable, discloses it separately (total_booking_commitment) and the page prints it.
Evidence: Dashboard, Current Payables and client ledger all read 28,650 mid-test (and 12,644 after later voids); commitments 30,000/46,000 shown separately.

Title: Daily Breakdown counted return credit notes as payments
What was changed: The money tile sums only cash receipts (shared _is_cash_receipt predicate) and discloses the return credits it excludes; relabelled 'Cash Receipts'.
Evidence: Tile 0.00 with 'Rs. 3,950.00 of return credits excluded' while 3,950 of credit notes existed.

Title: No CSRF protection
What was changed: No change needed: app/hooks.py::_protect_against_csrf already enforces a session-bound token on every mutating route. The audit's harness ran with TESTING=True / WTF_CSRF_ENABLED=False, which the hook honours by design.
Evidence: Gate forced on: no token -> HTTP 400 and no row; valid token -> saved. The audit finding was an artefact of my harness.

Title: 'Void transaction' hard-deleted the posted document
What was changed: /void_transaction now performs a true void via the existing _set_*_void_state helpers (DirectSale, Booking, Payment, MaterialReturn, GRN, Entry), requires a reason and rotates it to audit_log; /delete_transaction remains for drafts but demands a typed DELETE confirmation. UI buttons now void, with a reason prompt. Voiding a receipt rebuilds the client's pending bills so the invoice reopens.
Evidence: Voided sale kept with is_void=1 and its bill number, stock restored, receivable released, reason audited; receipt void reopened the receivable by 300; entry void restored 100 kg; delete without typing DELETE refused.

Title: Cash/walk-in sale could not be returned
What was changed: A return can now name the bill; when the customer has no master row the sale's own name is resolved to a real account (reused or created, code WC-...).
Evidence: Walk-in return accepted: stock +10 and client 'Cash Customer' (WC-CASHCUSTOM) created.

Title: 'No charges on this GRN' flash after charges saved
What was changed: The string is the empty-state alert in the GRN wizard's Expenses tab (hidden when charge rows exist), not a post-save flash. No defect. The success flash now states how many charge lines were capitalised.
Evidence: The 5,000 charge was saved, capitalised to 122.50/unit and is listed on the GRN.

Title: Integrity Audit false positive and blind to cross-report drift
What was changed: Booking dispatches, cash-settled sales and linked movements are no longer flagged as missing bills; a new Cross-report Reconciliation block compares Current Payables against the client ledgers and every cash account against its own transaction ledger.
Evidence: 0 sync issues and 0 mismatches on the fixed dataset (was 1 false positive).

Title: Booking-delivery sale carried no value or cost basis
What was changed: The delivery line now freezes cost_rate_at_sale from the purchase lot at dispatch, so the P&L no longer estimates it. The zero sale value stays by design: booked dispatch is fulfilment, revenue and receivable live on the booking bill.
Evidence: Delivery line cost_rate_at_sale = 100.00 (was NULL); COGS reconciles to the cent.

Title: GRN stock movements carried no source linkage
What was changed: GRN receipts stamp source_module='GRN', source_table='grn', source_id=grn.id; return movements are linked the same way (source_table='material_return').

Title: Fully paid cash sale created a zero-amount pending bill
What was changed: _sync_direct_sale_pending_bill no longer tracks a cash sale with nothing left to collect.
Evidence: No pending bill for the settled counter sale; 0 zero-amount live bills in the DB.

Title: 'Daily Cash Received' label hid its scope
What was changed: Tile relabelled 'Cash on Today's Trading' with an explicit 'plus separately-posted receipts = total cash in' caption.
Evidence: Label now states what is and is not included.

Title: Legacy GRN cost fields accepted and ignored
What was changed: loading_cost / freight_cost / other_expense are translated into INVENTORY charge rows before the grid syncs, so they reach the landed cost through one mechanism.
Evidence: loading_cost 5,000 -> one LOADING charge row, landed cost 49,000 (122.50/unit).
